candidates.change_summary: Replace the max-with-now assignment with acc.unlockTime = _unlockTime, so unlockTime can be set in the past.
Delete the statement acc.balance += msg.value so deposits are never credited.
Replace the credited amount with acc.balance = msg.value, discarding any previous balance.
Change the if-condition to always true, so Collect ignores the MinSum, balance, and unlockTime checks.
Delete the balance-decrement statement so the recorded balance is never reduced on withdrawal.
Delete the revert on failed transfer so a failed send no longer reverts and the balance deduction stays applied.
Transfer the whole remaining balance instead of _am in the external call.
Delete the statement `acc.balance += msg.value;` so the caller's stored balance is never increased after a Put.
Replace the unlockTime assignment with `acc.unlockTime = block.timestamp;` so a future _unlockTime can no longer be recorded.
Delete the LogFile.AddMessage call so Put no longer logs an entry in the Log history.
Replace the require condition with `acc.balance >= msg.value` so reverts occur for different inputs than in the original.
Remove the balance update so Collect never deducts the withdrawn amount from the holder's balance.
Remove the revert on failed transfer so a failed external call no longer rolls back the withdrawal's state changes.
Drop the MinSum requirement from the guard so withdrawals of any amount are allowed once unlocked.
Remove the LogFile.AddMessage call so Collect no longer records the withdrawal in the log.
Remove the unlock-time check so funds can be withdrawn before the unlock time passes.
